text.p: Greece's central bank intervened and sold an unspecified amount of $ for drachmas driving ecu/drachma below 311 around 310.20/70 in hectic trading, dealers said.
"The central bank sold an unspecified amount of $ for drachmas and the drachma jumped against the ecu trading around 310.20/70 from 311.40/50 earlier on," a forex dealer said.
The central bank kept on checking $/drachma rates since this morning indicating its intention to intervene during the day, dealers said.

Interbank depo rates and forex forwards were softer after the central bank's intervention and fixed coupon bonds gained another half a point, dealers said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
